battle.name: 俄國-波斯戰爭
battle.brief: 俄國-波斯戰爭於一八〇四年在南高加索爆發，波斯進攻俄屬喬治亞，戰線其後延伸至亞塞拜然與亞美尼亞；輪發手槍（Wheellock pistol）於一五〇〇年列裝，是歐洲陸軍早期制式火槍之一。戰事延續至一八一三年，最終條約重新劃定兩國的高加索邊界。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 題名中的「一八○四年」是爆發年，不是終戰年；戰爭由一八○四年延續至一八一三年。正式交戰者是俄羅斯帝國與卡賈伊朗，中文所稱的波斯，指的是當時由卡賈王朝統治的伊朗。卡爾特利－卡赫蒂喬治亞已在一八○一年遭俄國兼併，當地親王與軍隊雖仍存在，實務上卻已納入俄方指揮、通行與補給體系，因此通常不列為獨立交戰國。戰場由東喬治亞平原、卡赫蒂與沙基，延伸到達吉斯坦的傑爾賓特、齊茲利亞爾、裏海西岸的阿斯塔拉、庫巴及蘭卡蘭。
countriesEn: The 1804 in the title is the year hostilities began, not the year the war ended; the conflict continued from 1804 to 1813. The formal belligerents were the Russian Empire and Qajar Iran, with Persia referring here to the state governed by the Qajar dynasty. Kartli-Kakheti Georgia had been annexed by Russia in 1801. Georgian princes and local troops continued to exist, but they were operationally incorporated into Russian command, communications, and supply arrangements, so Georgia is not normally counted as an independent belligerent. The theater extended from the eastern Georgian plain through Kakheti and Shaki into Azerbaijan, and northward through Derbent and Kizlyar in Dagestan to Astara, Quba, and Lankaran on the western Caspian coast.
people: 戰役最高層由俄軍總督帕維爾·齊奇亞諾夫與卡賈王法特－阿里沙對峙。米爾扎·阿加西率領一八○四年的入喬治亞軍隊，阿巴斯·米爾扎則在巴什卡迪克勒爾及後來的亞塞拜然戰線指揮波斯軍。一八○四年克爾察尼西的喬治亞部隊不可誤寫成埃雷克勒二世本人親自率領，因為埃雷克勒二世已於一七九八年去世；該地作戰者是由喬治亞親王與地方部隊指揮的聯合分遣隊。齊奇亞諾夫於一八○六年在齊茲利亞爾去世後，伊萬·帕斯凱維奇於一八一二年前後接手 Caucasus 戰區；奧爾洛夫－杰尼索夫參與阿斯蘭杜茲的渡河與側翼攻擊，法達利汗則在蘭卡蘭方向率領波斯援軍。
peopleEn: At the highest level, the confrontation was between the Russian commander Pavel Tsitsianov and the Qajar ruler Fath-Ali Shah. Mirza Aghasi led the Persian force that entered Georgia in 1804, while Abbas Mirza commanded at Bashkadiklar and later in the Azerbaijani theater. The Georgian troops at Krtsanisi must not be identified as King Erekle II personally, because he had died in 1798; they were a combined detachment commanded by Georgian princes and local officers. Tsitsianov died at Kizlyar in 1806, after which Ivan Paskevich took command of the Caucasian theater around 1812. Orlov-Denisov participated in the river crossing and flank attack at Aslanduz, while Fadali Khan led a Persian relief force in the Lankaran sector.
kits: 俄軍步兵主要使用一七九六年式滑膛燧發步槍與刺刀，哥薩克和普通騎兵則配卡賓槍、彎刀，哥薩克另帶長矛。俄軍野戰砲連在一八○四年已配備十二磅野砲、十磅榴彈砲及隨gun裝載的彈藥車，攻略傑爾賓特等要塞時還可調用大口徑攻城砲與臼砲。卡賈各支軍隊的裝備較不一致，步兵常見長管杰茲伊爾槍、圖凡格式火繩槍或燧發槍，近戰使用 Khanjar、佩劍與盾牌，騎兵使用彎刀、長矛，並保有弓箭與青銅滑膛砲。俄軍以牛車、騾馬和渡河船把糧食、鹹肉、飼料、火藥、球彈及爆炸物送往前線，主要道路由第比利斯經卡赫蒂與阿拉扎尼河谷，另以齊茲利亞爾－傑爾賓特線維持達吉斯坦方向；卡賈軍則依賴南亞塞拜然的軍用倉儲、隨軍輜重與沿途飼料站。
kitsEn: Russian infantry primarily carried Model 1796 smoothbore flintlock muskets with bayonets, while Cossack and regular cavalry used carbines and sabres, with the Cossacks also carrying lances. Russian artillery companies already fielded 12-pounder guns, 10-pounder howitzers, and ammunition vehicles traveling with the pieces in 1804; heavy siege guns and mortars could also be assigned against fortresses such as Derbent. Qajar formations were less standardized. Infantry commonly used long jezails, tufang-pattern matchlocks or flintlocks, khanjars, swords, and shields, while cavalry carried sabres and lances, with bows and bronze muzzle-loading guns also retained. Russian ox wagons, mules, packhorses, and river boats carried grain, salted meat, fodder, powder, shot, and explosive ammunition forward. The main supply road ran from Tiflis through Kakheti and the Alazani valley, while the Kizlyar-Derbent route supported operations in Dagestan; the Qajar army depended on military magazines in southern Azerbaijan, column baggage trains, and established forage stations.
tactics: 俄軍的野戰縱隊通常由步兵營、砲兵連、哥薩克或Regular騎兵 regiments及工兵分遣隊組成。步兵以營展開為接續橫隊或縱隊，先由砲兵集中射擊，再以整齊射線推进；騎兵擔任兩翼掩護、追擊和切斷退路，工兵則處理渡河、設障及圍城陣地。卡賈軍則把王室直屬部隊、步兵、地方騎兵與青銅砲組合成機動較大的兵團，在會戰中重視側翼襲擊、騎兵衝擊與集中火炮。克爾察尼西的卡賈軍以主動進攻取得優勢；巴什卡迪克勒爾一役則由俄軍以火炮、步兵縱隊與預備隊协同取勝。阿斯蘭杜茲的關鍵是帕斯凱維奇利用夜色渡過阿斯塔拉河，先奪渡口，再攻擊尚未完全展開的阿巴斯·米爾扎營地。蘭卡蘭攻防中，俄軍不直接撞擊城牆，而是以封鎖、壕溝、圍城砲陣與控制道路提高守軍斷糧及失去外援的機率。
tacticsEn: A Russian field column normally combined infantry battalions, artillery companies, Cossack or regular cavalry regiments, and a pioneer detachment. Infantry deployed in battalion line or column, came under concentrated artillery fire, and then advanced in organized ranks; cavalry covered the flanks, pursued defeated troops, and cut escape routes, while engineers handled river crossings, obstacles, and siege positions. Qajar forces combined units directly connected to the shah, infantry, regional cavalry, and bronze artillery into a more mobile combined-arms force that emphasized flank attacks, mounted charges, and concentrated guns. At Krtsanisi, the Qajar offensive produced the victory; at Bashkadiklar, Russian guns, infantry columns, and reserves operated together more effectively. The decisive feature at Aslanduz was Paskevich's night crossing of the Astara River, seizure of the bridgehead, and attack on Abbas Mirza's camp before it could fully deploy. At Lankaran, the Russians relied on blockade, trenches, siege batteries, and control of the roads rather than a direct assault on the walls.
data: 一八○四年春末，俄軍在達吉斯坦方向封鎖齊茲利亞爾，守軍不久投降，該堡隨後成為北高加索的出發點；六月十八日，米爾扎·阿加西率軍在東喬治亞的克爾察尼西擊敗喬治亞與俄軍分遣隊，一度迫使聯軍退向第比利斯。齊奇亞諾夫完成整補後沿卡赫蒂向東推進，八月下旬在巴什卡迪克勒爾擊敗阿巴斯·米爾扎的軍隊，該日期通常記為八月二十四日，部分來源因曆法不同而相差一日。同年十月，沙基的卡賈當局與俄軍達成轉交安排；至一八○五年二月，遭陸路封鎖的傑爾賓特投降。此後俄軍雖掌握齊茲利亞爾、沙基與傑爾賓特，卻尚未穩固控制甘賈、巴庫及蘭卡蘭。齊奇亞諾夫於一八○六年去世，古多維奇接任後在 glucoz 對甘賈的攻勢於一八○七年受挫；一八○一年，占Clearance的戰役成為 Pereira 與伊朗守住西北前線的重要短暫成果。一八一二年前後帕斯凱維奇接手戰區，八月三十日至三十一日夜渡過阿斯塔拉河，以突襲攻下阿斯蘭杜茲營地，奪取卡賈砲、輜重與大量軍用物資，但阿巴斯·米爾扎本人逃脫。九月，庫巴落入俄軍之手；十月二十三日，俄軍開始封鎖蘭卡蘭，守軍於一八一三年四月十九日投降。六月十六日，法達利汗率領的波斯援軍又在蘭卡蘭附近被俄軍擊敗，最後的野戰主力才退出南高加索。現存俄文、波斯文與歐洲文記述所列兵力及傷亡彼此矛盾，無法形成可信的全戰役精確傷亡總數。
dataEn: In late spring 1804, Russian forces blockaded Kizlyar in the Dagestan direction and the garrison soon surrendered, turning the fortress into a starting point for operations in the North Caucasus. On 18 June, Mirza Aghasi defeated a combined Georgian-Russian detachment at Krtsanisi in eastern Georgia and drove it toward Tiflis. After regrouping, Tsitsianov advanced eastward through Kakheti and defeated Abbas Mirza's army at Bashkadiklar in late August, a date commonly recorded as 24 August, although some accounts differ by one day because of calendars. An arrangement transferring Shaki to Russian control followed in October, and Derbent surrendered after a land blockade in February 1805. Russia now held Kizlyar, Shaki, and Derbent but did not yet control Ganja, Baku, or Lankaran securely. Tsitsianov died in 1806, and his successor Gudovich suffered a reverse in his 1807 offensive against Ganja. In 1811, Javad Khan's Persian victory at Kianchallub temporarily secured the northwestern frontier. Paskevich took over the theater around 1812. During the night of 30 and 31 August, he crossed the Astara River and struck the Aslanduz camp, capturing Persian guns, baggage, and substantial military stores, although Abbas Mirza escaped. Quba fell in September. On 23 October the Russians began the blockade of Lankaran, whose garrison surrendered on 19 April 1813. On 16 June, a Persian relief army led by Fadali Khan was defeated near Lankaran, removing the last organized field force from the southern Caucasus. Russian, Persian, and European accounts give incompatible strength and casualty figures, so no reliable exact total for the entire war can be established.
cause: 直接背景是俄羅斯、格魯吉亞與卡賈伊朗在東高加索權力關係的逆轉。一七八三年，卡爾特利－卡赫蒂與俄國訂立保護關係；一八○一年，俄皇保羅一世單方面宣布將該王國兼併，使喬治亞不再保有獨立外交與軍權。法特－阿里沙於一八○四年鞏固王位後，認為恢復卡賈對喬治亞及北亞塞拜然汗區的宗主權是首要任務，不能接受俄軍長期駐紮並控制卡爾特利與卡赫蒂。俄羅斯則把喬治亞、達吉斯坦和裏海西部通道視為高加索邊防的連續支柱。米爾扎·阿加西的軍隊越境並在克爾察尼西取勝，遂使爭端由外交要求轉為軍事衝突；因此，一八○四年的入侵是直接導火線，而喬治亞兼併、卡賈對西部的宗主主張與俄軍前沿部署才是延續多年的根本原因。
causeEn: The immediate background was the reversal of power relations among Russia, Georgia, and Qajar Iran in the eastern Caucasus. In 1783, Kartli-Kakheti entered a protectorate relationship with Russia; in 1801, Emperor Paul I unilaterally proclaimed its annexation, ending Georgia's independent diplomacy and military autonomy. After consolidating his position in 1804, Fath-Ali Shah treated the restoration of Qajar authority over Georgia and the northern Azerbaijani khanates as a priority and would not accept a permanent Russian military presence in Kartli and Kakheti. Russia, in turn, regarded Georgia, Dagestan, and the routes toward the western Caspian as a connected strategic system for its Caucasian frontier. Mirza Aghasi's crossing of the frontier and victory at Krtsanisi turned a diplomatic dispute into armed conflict. The invasion was therefore the immediate trigger, while the annexation of Georgia, Persian claims in the west, and the deployment of Russian troops along the frontier formed the deeper causes.
impact: 這場戰爭的主要影響不是某一場會戰的傷亡數字，而是俄軍在高加索建立了一條可以相互支援的堡壘與補給鏈。齊茲利亞爾、沙基、傑爾賓特、阿斯塔拉、庫巴與蘭卡蘭依序落入俄方控制，使第比利斯方向、北高加索與裏海西岸不再是彼此孤立的三個戰區；帕斯凱維奇在一八一二至一八一三年間的推進，正是利用這些據點縮短行軍距離。對卡賈伊朗而言，喬治亞不再是可望收復的目標，南高加索汗區也失去重要兵源、火砲與軍馬供應基地。法特－阿里沙仍保住伊朗國家與中央軍隊，但阿巴斯·米爾扎在戰後退出主要指揮位置。俄軍取得優勢也沒有終結雙方爭端，伊朗在一八二六至一八二八年戰爭中曾奪回多數今天屬於亞塞拜然的土地，證明一八一三年的結果是邊界與控制權的改變，而非波斯政治實體消失。
impactEn: The war's principal effect lay not in any single casualty figure but in the creation of a mutually supporting chain of Russian forts and supply points. Kizlyar, Shaki, Derbent, Astara, Quba, and Lankaran gave Russia connected positions between Tiflis, the North Caucasus, and the western Caspian. Paskevich's advances in 1812 and 1813 depended on shortening movement along that chain. For Qajar Iran, Georgia ceased to be a realistic object of reconquest, and the southern Caucasian khanates were removed as major sources of troops, artillery, and military horses. Fath-Ali Shah preserved the Iranian state and its central army, but Abbas Mirza was removed from his principal command position after the defeat. Russia's advantage did not end the rivalry: during the Russo-Persian War of 1826 to 1828, Iran recovered much of the territory now in Azerbaijan, showing that Gulistan changed control and frontiers rather than erasing Iran as a political power.
result: 一八一三年十月二十四日，即俄曆十月十二日，俄羅斯帝國與卡賈伊朗在古利斯坦村簽訂和約，實際結束了這場戰爭的主要階段。伊朗代表米爾扎·阿卜勒－卡西姆·卡伊姆－馬卡姆在權限受到限制的情況下簽署條約；卡賈一方放棄對喬治亞與多數南高加索汗區的主權主張，俄國則確認其對達吉斯坦、喬治亞及今天亞塞拜然大部分地區的既有控制，並取得在裏海維持海軍力量的專屬權利。甘賈與卡拉巴赫等汗國一度由地方汗統治、接受俄方宗主權，沒有立即全部改為俄羅斯省制；蘭卡蘭投降與六月戰敗則使阿巴斯·米爾za's 大軍失去繼續會戰的基地。作戰結果因此明確偏向俄國，但未摧毀卡賈國家。戰爭造成的精確全軍傷亡至今無法可靠核定，任何單一精確數字都會超出現存史料的一致證據範圍。
resultEn: On 24 October 1813, equivalent to 12 October under the Julian calendar used in Russia, the Russian Empire and Qajar Iran concluded the Treaty of Gulistan, ending the principal phase of the war. The Persian representative Mirza Abol-Qasem Qa'em-Maqam signed under restricted authority, and the agreement was later criticized within Iran. The Qajar side renounced its claims to Georgia and most of the southern Caucasian khanates. Russia confirmed its existing control in Dagestan and Georgia and over most of the territory now in Azerbaijan, while receiving exclusive rights to maintain a naval force on the Caspian Sea. Ganja and Karabakh remained for a time under local khanates operating within Russian suzerainty and were not immediately converted into uniformly administered Russian provinces. The surrender of Lankaran and the defeat in June removed the base Abbas Mirza needed to continue major field operations. The operational result therefore clearly favored Russia, but it did not destroy the Qajar state. No reliable aggregate casualty total for the entire war exists, and any single exact figure would exceed what the surviving evidence can consistently support.
